title: SEC Filings Data Engineering & Search API
summary: A technical-challenge project implementing an end-to-end ETL pipeline, star-schema data warehouse, and semantic search API over SEC filings data. It uses SDV's HMASynthesizer with MultiTableMetadata to generate the synthetic raw filings data that seeds the entire pipeline.
evidence: generate_sdv_data.py:96 'synthesizer = HMASynthesizer(metadata)' with MultiTableMetadata imported and fit on real_data
